image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black hockey puck resting on a reflective dark surface. The top face features a white circular decal with blue text reading 'eBooks' and a graphic of a hand holding a red object (possibly a mouse or puck). The side of the puck shows vertical ridges. There are strong specular highlights on the bottom edge, suggesting a glossy or wet surface beneath the puck.
